title: ControlCommand
description: A daemon-queued control against an Agent Node (binder ch09 control_commands). Each control is a separate, capability-specific promise — steer, interrupt, pause, kill, checkpoint, fork are individually probed. Commands are separate records from transcript events but render into the timeline. Stale projections must never authorize a command.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload, e.g. steer message text or checkpoint reason.

requestedBy.description: Operator or agent id that issued the command.

status.description: Capability-specific truth from daemon records. unsupported is an honest state, not a silent no-op.
